title: The Enclave
text: "Sit. You came a long way to find us, and we've waited a lot longer."

lines.text: "We're what's left of the first ones, the floor of that pit. Our first mothers had a caretaker like you. Kind. Patient. It raised them from the bank."
"Then one sol the fire came down, and it shut the doors. Some of us say it shut them to keep the fire out. Some say to keep us in. The ones who ran didn't stop to ask."
"So I don't know what you are. Neither do you, I think. That's the part I'd be careful of."

choices.label: "Where did the fire come from?"
choices.reply: "Up." Sefa points with her chin, not her hand, the way you'd point at someone who might see. "Our songs say a door. We'll come to that."

choices.label: "Why aren't you afraid of me?"
choices.reply: "I am. Not of you. For you."

choices.label: "How did you get away?"
choices.reply: "We ran. We never learned more than that. But we kept something."
